{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to correct for overconfidence in upward moves.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) when price is trending downward, as models tend to overreact.",
    "When true outcome spikes sharply (e.g., >10% from prior day), reduce forecast overshoot by 10–20% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment is strongly bullish.",
    "In late periods (last 5 days of forecast), increase downward bias if sentiment is neutral or negative to prevent overestimation of upward momentum.",
    "If sentiment is positive (≥0.25), allow slight upward bias but cap forecast at 10% above recent 5-day high to avoid overextension.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is >10% above forecast at day 10–15, adjust downward by 5–10% to account for delayed market reaction."
  ]
}
